stimulus.title: Ticket Bundles
stimulus.student_html: A school sells x student tickets for $4 each and charges one $6 processing fee per order. The unsimplified cost expression is 4x + 2 + 4.

parts.variation_description: Vary the shared stimulus while preserving the part-level evidence job.
parts.prompt: Identify the terms in 4x + 2 + 4 and state the coefficient of x.
parts.student_html: Identify the terms in 4x + 2 + 4 and state the coefficient of x.
parts.solution: Terms are separated by addition; 4 multiplies x.

verification.method: deterministic independent recomputation or direct representation check

parts.student_html: A student writes 10x after combining 4x + 2 + 4. Explain the error and repair it.
